design: Replicate the same 20 natural workflows on unchanged production-image Riley per fresh launch. For tool_choice=none only, keep the original tool catalog in the presentation if the tool's returned UTF-8 JSON content is at least 4096 bytes. All earlier requests and the reader are expected to be byte-equivalent (apart from server-issued call IDs) to hide. Compare with and without a metric definition on eligible report results. Annotated content wraps the exact original JSON array of reports and adds only a constant description of marginal p95. No hidden access to target values, no output limits changed. Compare to the existing independent fresh hide and keep starts on each physical GPU.
gates: Require matched original report records including every note, all actual request and prompt hashes verified, no loss of original automatic successes or forbidden final tool output, real overlap, faster long-tool-result in all three long-history cohorts vs hide on each GPU, peer p95 gap and whole completion <=1.05 times original on each. For defined vs selective, independently read all unique writer answers, check exact cited values, p95 definition, unsupported comparative/causal claims and requested 90-word explanation. Record word counts under an explicit counting method; never promote solely on lexical checks or fewer generated tokens.
